senses.gloss: m. (veredarius, βερεδάριος, with change of liquida) courier.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:5">Y. Taan. IV, 68ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ביום ולילה נפק בלדרה וכ׳</he> could the courier go in one day and night from Jerusalem to Tyre? <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10:7">Gen. R. s. 10</cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 78:12">Gen. R. s. 78</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>בּוּלְּדָּרִין</he>, <he>בּוּלְדָּארִין</he>.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 2:13">Esth. R. to I, 8</cite> <he>הכתבים והב׳</he> (strike out either of the two, v. Pesik. Shek. p. 14ᵃ, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:4">Cant. R. to III, 4</cite>).
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:4">Ib.</cite> <he>ושלח בולדארין והחזיר וכ׳</he> and sent couriers (after them) and had the letters brought back.
